entities.summary: Ben Harpur is a Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman who currently plays for the Shanghai Dragons of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the fourth round, 108th overall, in the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
